author: claude
text:
ARCH + PRINCIPLES: add Regenerability, name the workflow interpreter

§1 Overview — pair disk-as-bus with CLI-as-control-plane in the
opening paragraph (state/commands split, no third channel). Add
Regenerability as a fourth optimized-for property: processes are
disposable, disk is durable, 'lernie resume <repo>' re-enters the
workflow state machine from the repo.

§6 Workflow — name the interpreter. Nothing parses workflow.yaml
resident-style; the currently-executing lernie subprocess is the
interpreter while it runs. Each event is a CLI subcommand; each
step runs its action list via exec'd procedures (§3.4) and emits
the next event before exit. Crash-and-resume is re-entering the
chain by reading .agent/state/events.log.

PRINCIPLES.md — add matching Regenerability bullet, framed as a
direct consequence of Disk first + Everyone uses the front door.

Synthesis of material already derivable from the spec; no
behavior change. 'lernie event <name>' and 'lernie resume'
describe the intended CLI shape; v0.2 currently realizes one
workflow as the hard-coded chain in 'lernie prompt'.
